BASE_ITER=2 BEST (proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, 12 params, hr 0.028237, ep24). ONE KNOB: proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001 (5x TIGHTER = edge-preserving in the PROJECTION domain -- the campaign-state-named, substrate-specific, headroom-aligned lever that has NEVER been moved on this run). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 hr 0.027984 ep8; iter-2 hr 0.028237 ep24 = BEST (epochs INERT); iter-3 hr 0.0 img_n_bf=6 (image capacity DESTABILIZED); iter-4 hr 0.028237 proj_n_bf=2 (proj-DEPTH FLAT); iter-5 hr 0.009801 train_n=480 (DATA REGRESSED -- too small to exploit data); iter-6 hr 0.021479 lr=0.001 (lr-DOWN REGRESSED); iter-7 hr 0.028192 img_sr=0.005 (image range-sigma FLAT/INERT). MAPPED knobs: epochs, img_n_bf, proj_n_bf, train_n, lr, img_sr -- all spent. (2) LIMITER: NOT yet a pure structural ceiling -- one named, headroom-aligned scalar is genuinely UNTRIED. The campaign-state doc (mayo_campaign_state.md L212): >>Mayo (2304-view) -- the IMAGE-domain sigma is inert and proj_sr-DOWN is the lever<<. iter-7 just CONFIRMED the image-domain img_sr is inert on Mayo (0.02->0.005 flat 0.0282), exactly as the doc predicts -- which elevates proj_sr-DOWN from candidate to THE clean falsifier. proj_sr has been FROZEN at 0.0005 for all 7 iters; it is an INIT but the supervised MSE does NOT free it as a trainable DOF the way img_sr is (the projection-domain BF range-sigma controls how much CORRELATED sinogram noise is smoothed BEFORE the 2304-view FBP adjoint amplifies it -- a pre-FBP locus the image-domain knobs cannot reach). (3) ONE KNOB = proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001 (5x DOWN). JUSTIFICATION vs the other untried scalars (proj_sx/proj_sy spatial sigmas, proj_kernel, seed, lambda_neg, grad_clip): proj_sr-DOWN is the ONE the campaign-state doc explicitly names as THE Mayo bilateral lever and aligns with the RMSE-sensitive headroom direction (tighter range-sigma = LESS smoothing = edge-preserving = the headroom-favored direction, since SSIM rewards blur but hr penalizes it). The spatial sigmas / kernel / seed are unmapped but NOT doc-flagged; proj_sr is the highest-value single shot. (4) HYPOTHESIS: proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001 lifts hr above 0.028237 because a tighter projection-domain range-sigma makes the pre-FBP sinogram bilateral edge-preserving rather than blurring, letting the RMSE-driven supervised-MSE recover sharper structure that the 321px-FOV headroom metric credits -- the exact image-domain analogue (img_sr-down) was just shown inert, but the doc says the PROJECTION domain is where the Mayo lever lives. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr stays <=0.030 (flat) OR regresses at proj_sr=0.0001, the LAST doc-named headroom-aligned scalar is exhausted -> FILE THE STRUCTURAL-CEILING VERDICT: hr~0.028 is the 12-param trainable-bilateral structural ceiling on real 2304-view Mayo LDCT, confirmed-robust across epochs, BOTH-domain capacity, data-coverage, learning-rate, image-domain range-sigma, AND the doc-named projection-domain range-sigma -- no within-architecture scalar escapes it; remaining iters toward iter-20 are pure confirmations (proj_sx/proj_sy/seed). (5) BUDGET: HARD 1200s train+score. proj_sr is an init change = ZERO extra compute. iter-2 (ep24/tn200/12p) ran 449.6s -> this run ~450s, comfortably <1200s (30-min sbatch wall). epochs=24 KEPT, train_n=200 KEPT (iter-2 base), img_n_bf=3 KEPT, proj_n_bf=1 KEPT, all OTHER sigmas/kernels/lr/img_sr(=0.02)/lambda_neg/seed identical to iter-2 BASE, val_n=214 KEPT, grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned.
